name: Cortadel Memory
description: Self-hosted long-term temporal graph memory for OpenClaw. Adds Cortadel as an additive memory corpus, two agent tools, and optional automatic recall/capture around every turn.

baseUrl.label: Cortadel Base URL
baseUrl.help: Hosted Cortadel is https://app.cortadel.ai. A self-hosted `docker compose up` listens on http://localhost:3001. Falls back to the CORTADEL_BASE_URL env var.

apiKey.label: Cortadel API Key
apiKey.help: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. Self-hosted Cortadel defaults to auth disabled, so this may be omitted. Prefer a SecretRef ({"source":"env","provider":"default","id":"CORTADEL_API_KEY"}) or ${CORTADEL_API_KEY} over storing the key here.

userId.label: User ID
userId.help: The Cortadel namespace that owns these memories. Every memory is anchored to it. Falls back to the CORTADEL_USER_ID env var.

recallScope.label: Recall Scope
recallScope.help: How wide a memory namespace a turn recalls from, and writes to. `fixed` keeps one shared namespace (best for a personal assistant). `agent`, `session`, and `sender` suffix the user id so multiple agents, conversations, or people each get an isolated memory namespace.

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Search Cortadel before each model call and prepend the matching memories to the turn context.

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Send each completed user/assistant turn to Cortadel so it can distil durable facts from it.

corpusSupplement.label: Expose as Memory Corpus
corpusSupplement.help: Register Cortadel as an additive corpus behind OpenClaw's own memory_search / memory_get tools. Additive: it does not replace the built-in memory backend.

promptSupplement.label: Prompt Section
promptSupplement.help: Add a short cached system-prompt section telling the model that Cortadel long-term memory is available.

topK.label: Top K Results
topK.help: Maximum memories retrieved per recall (1-50). Also the fallback when the cortadel_search_memory tool omits its own topK.

minScore.label: Minimum Score
minScore.help: Drop recalled memories whose fused RRF score is below this value. 0 keeps everything.

rerank.label: Cross-Encoder Rerank
rerank.help: Rerank search results with Cortadel's local cross-encoder. More accurate, slower.

timeoutMs.label: Request Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.help: Per-call budget for every Cortadel request. On timeout the turn continues without memory.

dedupeWindow.label: Recall Dedupe Window
dedupeWindow.help: Remembers this many recently injected memory ids per session and skips re-injecting them on later turns. 0 disables deduplication.

minPromptChars.label: Minimum Prompt Length
minPromptChars.help: Skip auto-recall for prompts shorter than this, so trivial turns do not spend a search.

circuitBreaker.label: Circuit Breaker
circuitBreaker.help: After maxFailures consecutive Cortadel errors, memory is skipped for cooldownMs before being retried. Keeps an unreachable memory server from slowing every turn.

tags.label: Capture Tags
tags.help: Tags applied to every fact captured from a turn, for scoped retrieval later.

project.label: Project Scope
project.help: Project scope recorded on captured facts, for example a repository name.

baseUrl.description: Cortadel server base URL. Defaults to http://localhost:3001 or the CORTADEL_BASE_URL env var.

apiKey.description: Bearer token. Prefer a SecretRef or ${CORTADEL_API_KEY} over a plaintext value.

userId.description: Cortadel user id that owns these memories. Defaults to "default" or the CORTADEL_USER_ID env var.

appName.description: App name recorded on Cortadel searches for access logging. Defaults to cortadel-openclaw.

recallScope.description: How wide a memory namespace a turn recalls from and writes to: fixed (one shared namespace), agent, session, or sender. Defaults to fixed.

autoRecall.description: Inject relevant memories before each model call.

autoCapture.description: Persist each completed turn to Cortadel.

corpusSupplement.description: Expose Cortadel behind OpenClaw's built-in memory_search / memory_get tools.

promptSupplement.description: Add a cached system-prompt section advertising Cortadel memory.

topK.description: Maximum memories retrieved per recall, and the fallback when the cortadel_search_memory tool omits its own topK. Defaults to 5.

minScore.description: Minimum fused RRF score for a recalled memory. Defaults to 0.

rerank.description: Use Cortadel's cross-encoder reranker on search.

timeoutMs.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 5000.

dedupeWindow.description: Per-session count of recently injected memory ids to suppress. Defaults to 200. 0 disables.

minPromptChars.description: Skip auto-recall for prompts shorter than this. Defaults to 8.

maxFailures.description: Consecutive failures before memory is skipped. Defaults to 3.

cooldownMs.description: How long to skip memory after the breaker opens. Defaults to 60000.

tags.description: Tags applied to every captured fact.

project.description: Project scope recorded on captured facts.
